meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides app download prompts, banners, footer; dims artwork; web app gift, Nitro, Active Now, avatar and media controls
meta.notes:
**Checked** 2026-11-07 and again 2026-11-13 in headless Chromium, iPhone UA, 390x844, logged out.

The recipe applies to `discord.com` and every subdomain. Logged out, only the marketing home `https://discord.com/` has anything to hide; `/app` redirects to `/login` (a plain form, nothing hidden), and `/nitro`, `/quests`, `/download` have none of these elements.

## Live counts on the home page (LIVE)

- `body:has(div.home--hero) a[href*="/api/downloads/distributions/"]` matched 3 (hero, mobile menu, closing band; the same href matches 18 links on `/download`, hence the scope). `div.discord_banner` matched 1 (631px closing band).
- `.footer_new` matched 1 (visible). The `<footer>` tag on this page only holds a decorative robot animation, so it is not used.
- `.home--image-wr` matched 8 (visible), and holds all 6 `main video` loops. `.star-hero-home` matched 89 (5 in view at load).
- `#onetrust-consent-sdk` matched 1 but empty and 0px: the banner never rendered in this session (region), so the rule is SOURCE (OneTrust standard markup, EasyList cookie lists), not LIVE. `#onetrust-banner-sdk` matched 0.

## Logged-in web app rules (NOT verified live)

These need a login, so they come from public community lists and are matched on the stable class prefix because the real class names carry a hash suffix. The fixture `app.html` is hand-written.

- SOURCE `button[aria-label="Send a gift"]` (espimarisa userCSS gist; English UI only). SOURCE `[class*="channelAppLauncher"]` (ikl.sh/garden/discord_ublock, Aug 2024).
- SOURCE `[class*="nowPlayingColumn"]` (JustZix example; toydotgame Vencord CSS; r/BetterDiscord threads). Dec 2025 reports say some older selectors broke, so expect drift.
- SOURCE `img[class*="avatar_"]`: `avatar_` class names exist in the shipped login-page CSS (`avatar_SISQ-M` and others).
- INFERRED `a[href="/store"]` and `a[href="/shop"]` inside `[class*="privateChannels"]` (the people hiding these use a text xpath, not an href; hrefs recalled from the client). INFERRED `imageWrapper_` and `embedWrapper_` (long-lived names in community themes; not present in the login CSS chunks).

## Left alone on purpose

The Open Discord in your browser button, the nav and footer `/download` links, the login form, and everything in the message composer except the two upsell buttons.
